name: Garlic-Rosemary Drumsticks & Cheesy Smashed Cauliflower with Chives

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg fresh rosemary
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Slide rosemary leaves off the sprigs; discard sprigs and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the herb paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken on the baking sheet; using your hands, coat drumsticks with herb paste and arrange in a single layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until golden brown and cooked through, about 35 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water is heating, cut each cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard leaves and thick stem. Separate into 2-inch wide florets.
Once the water comes to a boil, uncover and add cauliflower; stir for a few seconds. Cover and return to a boil; cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
While the cauliflower is cooking, grate the cheese. Chop chives into small pieces.
Drain cauliflower, then carefully divide florets between two additional baking sheets; drizzle with oil and season with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a fork or potato masher, gently crush each cauliflower floret, flattening them to about a ½-inch thickness. Gather any loose cauliflower pieces into small piles of about the same size.
Sprinkle cauliflower with cheese and chives.
Add baking sheets to the oven and bake until cheese is golden and bubbly, about 7 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide drumsticks and cheesy cauliflower between plates. Enjoy!
